diagnostics.message:
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
`:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng` uses `aws_iam_role.ng` for its nodes but does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed`. When `enable_ssm` is set, the SSM policy must be attached to the node role before instances boot so the SSM agent can register; the sibling Worker/CNI/ECR attachments are already in `depends_on`, but this one is omitted.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
`:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng` reuses the node role and its launch template (`aws_launch_template.mng`) enables the SSM agent when `var.enable_ssm` is true, yet its depends_on only covers `eks-ng`, `eks-cni` and `ecr-read`. It should also wait for `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed` so managed node instances never launch without SSM permissions attached to the role. No attribute reference can express this, so extend the existing depends_on list.

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng` (self-managed nodes) launches instances assuming the `aws_iam_role.ng` role, but does not depend on `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed`. When `enable_ssm` is set, the SSM policy must be attached to the role before instances launch so the SSM agent registers; the Worker/CNI/ECR attachments are already in `depends_on`, but this one is omitted.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
`:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng` launches self-managed nodes whose user-data installs and starts the SSM agent when `var.enable_ssm` is true, but it only depends on `eks-ng`, `eks-cni` and `ecr-read` policy attachments. Nothing orders it after `:resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.ssm-managed`, so instances can boot (and go live without SSM access) before the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy is attached to the node role. Add this attachment to the existing depends_on list (no attribute reference exists to create it implicitly).
